value_or_angle: old="How are you connected to the founders?" header="How are you connected to the founders?" body="I'm a Northern Californian because of two migrations: my father's side came west in 1851, when Charles Hooker and two of his brothers left the family homestead in New Hampshire and he started a hardware business in San Francisco, and my mother's mother took her family west to get a new start. I always assumed the Hooker line ran through my father, and that my mother was directly descended from another Hartford founder, John Talcott; then I learned she descends from Thomas Hooker too. All told, I'm connected to 22 of Hartford's original founders through 27 direct lines, including three to John Stanley and two to Stephen Hart." category=family
